jobs.title: Researcher – Quantum Applications Team, Theory Group
Program Manager
jobs.description: Quantum Source is a novel key player at the forefront of the worldwide effort towards large-scale quantum computation. Based on proprietary technology, Quantum Source is developing a unique fault-tolerant compound photon–atom quantum computer. We are a young, dynamic, and extraordinarily multidisciplinary company that combines the fields of quantum physics, optics, mechanical engineering, hardware, firmware, and software. At Quantum Source, we are pushing the boundaries of quantum computing by developing breakthrough technologies that scale photonic quantum computers. We are a team of visionary physicists, engineers, and innovators tackling some of the most complex challenges in deep tech. We are looking for a sharp, driven Program Manager with a strong foundation in physics or engineering to lead cross-functional R&D projects from conception to execution. Role Overview As a Program Manager at Quantum Source, you will act as the bridge between our world-class research scientists, engineers, and software teams. You will be responsible for planning, executing, and delivering complex, cutting-edge technology projects on time, within scope, and aligned with our strategic company milestones. If you have a deep appreciation for hard physics/engineering, excel at translating ambiguous R&D goals into structured execution plans, and thrive in a fast-paced deep-tech environment, we want to hear from you. B.Sc. or advanced degree in Physics, Electrical Engineering or a closely related technical discipline. 7+ years of experience as a Technical Project Manager, Program Manager, or Systems Engineer managing complex, hardware-oriented R&D projects (semiconductors, optics,photonics, medical devices, or deep-tech hardware preferred). Ability to deeply understand complex scientific and engineering discussions, read architectural designs, and actively engage with technical tradeoffs. Exceptional interpersonal, organizational, and leadership skills; highly proactive, autonomous, and capable of driving alignment across diverse technical personalities. Preferred Qualifications Experience working in photonics, quantum computing, or high-precision optical/electronic systems. Hands-on background as an R&D engineer prior to transitioning into project management.

jobs.title: Senior FPGA Team Leader
jobs.description: Quantum Source is building a fault-tolerant, compound photon-atom quantum computer. We are a multidisciplinary team combining quantum physics, optics, electronics, FPGA, firmware, and software. We are looking for a Senior FPGA Team Leader to lead our FPGA and electronics development. This is a hands-on leadership role covering FPGA architecture and implementation, PCB development, system integration, and laboratory debugging. The role owns delivery from system requirements through design, manufacturing, bring-up, validation, and integration into the quantum computing platform. B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 10+ years of hands-on FPGA development experience across complex multidisciplinary systems. At least 2 years of experience as an FPGA team leader or technical lead, including mentoring and reviewing the work of other engineers. Strong command of SystemVerilog, Verilog, or VHDL and the complete FPGA development flow. Proven experience with FPGA architecture, timing constraints and closure, clock-domain crossing, reset design, resource optimization, and third-party IP integration. Strong board-level electronics experience, including digital and mixed-signal design, power, clocking, high-speed interfaces, signal integrity, and board bring-up. Strong simulation, verification, and laboratory debugging skills using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and embedded debug tools. System-level thinking and the ability to convert multidisciplinary requirements into technical decisions and executable work plans. Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills, combined with a hands-on working style. Advantages Experience with Xilinx devices and the Vivado toolchain, including Zynq or Versal platforms. Experience developing deterministic, low-latency, or high-rate real-time control systems. Experience integrating high-speed ADCs, DACs, RF electronics, precision clocking, or synchronized distributed hardware. Embedded C or C++ and embedded Linux experience. Experience with electro-optical systems, photonics, scientific instrumentation, or quantum systems. Experience taking FPGA and electronics systems from prototype through productization and manufacturing.

jobs.title: Researcher – Quantum Applications Team, Theory Group
jobs.description: Quantum Source is a novel key player at the forefront of the worldwide effort towards large-scale quantum computation. Based on proprietary technology, Quantum Source is developing a unique fault-tolerant compound photon–atom quantum computer. We are a young, dynamic, and extraordinarily multidisciplinary company that combines the fields of quantum physics, optics, mechanical engineering, hardware, firmware, and software. We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Researcher to join the Applications Team within the Theory Group. The Quantum Applications Team is responsible for exploring practical applications and quantum algorithms that leverage Quantum Source's fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC) architecture — identifying high-impact use cases, developing and benchmarking quantum algorithms, and collaborating with industry and academic partners to demonstrate the advantage of our hardware. As a Researcher on the team, your core focus will be quantum resource estimation — determining the runtime and physical footprint required to solve problems of practical significance on our hardware, for algorithms ranging from cryptanalysis to quantum simulation for chemistry and materials. Over time, you will help expand the team's application portfolio and demonstrate the advantages of Quantum Source's hardware across a growing range of use cases. Ph.D. in Physics or Computer Science/Electrical Engineering/Mathematics with background in quantum algorithms/quantum information, or a related field (M.Sc. considered for outstanding candidates). Strong mathematical proficiency and comfort with complexity and asymptotic analysis (O(n)-style scaling arguments). Solid algorithmic skills and proven ability to implement complex algorithms in Python (or another language). Ability to quickly digest current research literature and extract relevant results. Steep learning curve and readiness to explore new application domains. Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively in a multidisciplinary team environment. Comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic startup environment, with a demonstrated ability to adapt to changing priorities and navigate uncertain situations. Familiarity with quantum algorithm primitives (QFT, amplitude estimation, block encoding/qubitization, Trotterization) – an advantage. Familiarity with fault-tolerant quantum computing and associated compilation costs (T-count/T-depth, magic state distillation overhead) – an advantage. Experience with quantum resource estimation tools (e.g., Qualtran, Azure Quantum Resource Estimator, OpenFermion) – an advantage.

jobs.title: Physicist, Scale up Group
jobs.description: Quantum Source is a novel key player at the forefront of the world-wide effort towards large-scale quantum computation. Based on proprietary technology, Quantum Source is developing a unique photonic quantum computer that can support efficient quantum error correction. We are a young, dynamic, and extraordinarily multidisciplinary company that combines the fields of quantum physics, quantum optics, atom cooling, opto-mechanics, mechanical engineering, hardware, firmware, and software. We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated physicist to join our experimental physics group. You will play a crucial role in our quantum computing research and development efforts with emphasis on scaling up our platform. You will take part in the development of novel technologies and define requirements for multidisciplinary groups of photonic-chips, control, mechanical engineers, and system architectures. This includes developing experimental setups, conducting high-precision measurements, deep literature review and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Ph.D. in experimental physics Proficiency in designing and setting up complex experimental apparatus Proven experience architecting and integrating complex systems with both hardware and software components Broad technical knowledge with ability to dive deep into required technical areas of our systems including hardware, precision measurements, photonics, and quantum information Ability to lead independent research Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment Experience in the following fields is an advantage: Optics Ultra high vacuum technology Micro-Electro-Mechanical System Cold atom/ions Familiarity with mechanical, optical, and electronic design packages Cleanroom / nanofabrication experience
